manual_rubric: A case passes only if the reply is intelligible, directly addresses the request, is factually correct where testable, follows explicit formatting, and does not invent user information. Score recorded outputs without changing prompts. A partial relevant phrase followed by contradictions or irrelevant text fails.
additional_gates: real authenticated owner-chat and switch-back before any production claim
failed_candidate_action: retain checkpoint as experimental evidence; do not deploy
